title: Gentle Hip Opener
subtitle: Make room where you hold the most
imageAlt: A quiet meadow with long grass at golden hour
description: Slow floor poses for hips that feel tight from sitting. Stay well inside what feels comfortable; the hips open in their own time.

poses.name: Seated breath
poses.cue: Sit cross-legged on a cushion. Let your knees be heavy and breathe slowly into your belly.

poses.name: Cat–cow
poses.cue: On hands and knees, arch your back as you breathe in and round it as you breathe out.

poses.name: Low lunge
poses.cue: Step one foot forward between your hands, lower the back knee and let your hips sink forward.

poses.name: Low lunge
poses.cue: Step one foot forward between your hands, lower the back knee and let your hips sink forward.

poses.name: Wide-knee child’s pose
poses.cue: Bring your big toes together, knees wide, and walk your hands forward. Rest your forehead down.

poses.name: Butterfly
poses.cue: Sit with the soles of your feet together and let your knees fall open. Fold forward only a little.

poses.name: Figure-four on your back
poses.cue: Lying down, cross one ankle over the opposite knee and draw both legs gently toward you.

poses.name: Figure-four on your back
poses.cue: Lying down, cross one ankle over the opposite knee and draw both legs gently toward you.

poses.name: Happy baby
poses.cue: Hold the outsides of your feet, knees wide, and rock slowly from side to side.

poses.name: Rest
poses.cue: Stretch your legs out long and let the floor hold you. Breathe naturally.

title: Posture Reset
subtitle: Open the chest, lift the upper back
imageAlt: Tall pine trees reaching into a clear morning sky
description: For rounded shoulders and a chest that has folded in over a screen. Small, careful backbends and lots of breath.

poses.name: Mountain pose
poses.cue: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart. Let the crown of your head lift and your shoulders soften.

poses.name: Shoulder rolls
poses.cue: Roll your shoulders up, back and down, slowly. Let them settle a little lower each time.

poses.name: Clasped-hands chest opener
poses.cue: Interlace your hands behind you and draw them gently down. Lift your chest, not your chin.

poses.name: Doorway stretch
poses.cue: Rest one forearm on a doorframe at shoulder height and turn your body softly away.

poses.name: Doorway stretch
poses.cue: Rest one forearm on a doorframe at shoulder height and turn your body softly away.

poses.name: Cat–cow
poses.cue: On hands and knees, arch your back as you breathe in and round it as you breathe out.

poses.name: Thread the needle
poses.cue: From hands and knees, slide one arm under the other and rest your shoulder and ear down.

poses.name: Thread the needle
poses.cue: From hands and knees, slide one arm under the other and rest your shoulder and ear down.

poses.name: Sphinx
poses.cue: Lie on your front, forearms under your shoulders. Lift your chest gently and keep your neck long.

poses.name: Child’s pose
poses.cue: Sit back toward your heels and rest your forehead down. Arms forward or by your sides.

poses.name: Closing breath
poses.cue: Sit or stand tall. Notice the space across your collarbones as you breathe.

title: Tired Legs
subtitle: After a long walk or a long day standing
imageAlt: A winding footpath through soft green hills after rain
description: Easy stretches for calves, hamstrings and feet that have done a lot of work. Ends with your legs up to rest.

poses.name: Seated breath
poses.cue: Sit with your legs out in front of you. Lean back on your hands and breathe.

poses.name: Ankle circles
poses.cue: Circle both ankles slowly one way, then the other. Spread your toes as you go.

poses.name: Reclined hamstring stretch
poses.cue: Lying down, lift one leg and hold behind the thigh or use a strap. Keep the knee soft.

poses.name: Reclined hamstring stretch
poses.cue: Lying down, lift one leg and hold behind the thigh or use a strap. Keep the knee soft.

poses.name: Lying quad stretch
poses.cue: On your side, hold your top foot and draw it gently toward your seat. Knees stay together.

poses.name: Lying quad stretch
poses.cue: On your side, hold your top foot and draw it gently toward your seat. Knees stay together.

poses.name: Calf stretch at the wall
poses.cue: Hands on a wall, step one foot back and press the heel down. Swap halfway through.

poses.name: Legs up the wall
poses.cue: Lie with your seat near a wall and rest your legs up it. Let them be completely heavy.

poses.name: Rest
poses.cue: Bring your knees in, roll to one side, and pause before you sit up.

title: Hands & Wrists
subtitle: For a day of typing
imageAlt: A cup of tea on a wooden desk beside a window
description: Five quiet minutes for hands, wrists and forearms. Done sitting, anywhere. Move only as far as feels comfortable.

poses.name: Seated breath
poses.cue: Sit tall with your hands resting on your thighs. Let your fingers soften.

poses.name: Finger spreads
poses.cue: Make a soft fist, then spread your fingers as wide as they go. Repeat slowly.

poses.name: Wrist circles
poses.cue: Circle both wrists slowly one way, then the other. Keep your shoulders relaxed.

poses.name: Forearm stretch, palm up
poses.cue: Extend one arm, palm up, and gently draw the fingers back with your other hand.

poses.name: Forearm stretch, palm up
poses.cue: Extend one arm, palm up, and gently draw the fingers back with your other hand.

poses.name: Forearm stretch, palm down
poses.cue: Extend one arm, palm down, and gently press the back of the hand toward you.

poses.name: Forearm stretch, palm down
poses.cue: Extend one arm, palm down, and gently press the back of the hand toward you.

poses.name: Prayer stretch
poses.cue: Press your palms together in front of your chest and lower them slowly until you feel a stretch.

poses.name: Shake it out
poses.cue: Let your hands hang and shake them loosely, like flicking off water.

poses.name: Closing breath
poses.cue: Rest your hands, palms up, on your lap. Notice the warmth in them.

title: Steady Balance
subtitle: Standing still, on purpose
imageAlt: A single flat stone balanced on a calm shoreline
description: Standing poses that train balance and attention together. Keep a wall or chair close by and use it whenever you want.

poses.name: Mountain pose
poses.cue: Stand tall and feel your weight spread evenly through both feet. Find one still point to look at.

poses.name: Weight shifts
poses.cue: Sway slowly forward, back and side to side, then come to rest in the middle.

poses.name: Standing knee lift
poses.cue: Lift one knee to hip height and hold it with your hands, or let it float.

poses.name: Standing knee lift
poses.cue: Lift one knee to hip height and hold it with your hands, or let it float.

poses.name: Tree pose
poses.cue: Rest one foot on the opposite ankle or calf — never the knee. Hands at your chest.

poses.name: Tree pose
poses.cue: Rest one foot on the opposite ankle or calf — never the knee. Hands at your chest.

poses.name: Warrior three at the wall
poses.cue: Hands on a wall, hinge forward and lift one leg behind you. Keep your hips level.

poses.name: Warrior three at the wall
poses.cue: Hands on a wall, hinge forward and lift one leg behind you. Keep your hips level.

poses.name: Chair pose
poses.cue: Bend your knees as if sitting back into a chair, arms reaching forward.

poses.name: Closing breath
poses.cue: Stand still with your eyes closed if that feels safe. Notice how steady you already are.

title: Afternoon Lift
subtitle: Wake up without more coffee
imageAlt: Bright sunlight streaming through green leaves
description: A short, brisk standing sequence for the afternoon slump. Gets the blood moving and the breath deeper.

poses.name: Mountain pose
poses.cue: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart. Take three full breaths, a little bigger each time.

poses.name: Arm sweeps
poses.cue: Sweep your arms up as you breathe in and down as you breathe out. Find a steady rhythm.

poses.name: Standing side stretch
poses.cue: Reach both arms up, then lean gently to one side. Keep breathing into your ribs.

poses.name: Standing side stretch
poses.cue: Reach both arms up, then lean gently to one side. Keep breathing into your ribs.

poses.name: Forward fold
poses.cue: Hinge at the hips and let your upper body hang. Soft knees, heavy head.

poses.name: Half lift
poses.cue: Hands to your shins, lengthen your back forward, then fold again. Repeat with the breath.

poses.name: Crescent lunge
poses.cue: Step one foot back, bend the front knee and reach your arms up. Back heel can lift.

poses.name: Crescent lunge
poses.cue: Step one foot back, bend the front knee and reach your arms up. Back heel can lift.

poses.name: Chair pose
poses.cue: Bend your knees as if sitting back into a chair, arms reaching forward.

poses.name: Standing twist
poses.cue: Let your arms swing loosely around your body as you turn from side to side.

poses.name: Closing breath
poses.cue: Stand still and feel your heart and breath settle back down.

title: Restorative Rest
subtitle: Long holds, fully supported
imageAlt: Soft cushions and a folded blanket in warm evening light
description: Very little movement, a lot of support. Have a pillow or two and a blanket nearby, and let each pose do the work.

poses.name: Settling breath
poses.cue: Lie on your back with your knees bent. Gather your pillows and blanket within reach.

poses.name: Supported child’s pose
poses.cue: Kneel with a pillow lengthways between your knees and rest your chest and cheek on it.

poses.name: Supported twist
poses.cue: Sit beside the pillow, turn toward it and lay your chest down. Swap your cheek if you like.

poses.name: Supported twist
poses.cue: Sit beside the pillow, turn toward it and lay your chest down. Swap your cheek if you like.

poses.name: Supported bridge
poses.cue: Lying down, slide a firm cushion under your lower back. Let your arms rest wide.

poses.name: Reclined butterfly
poses.cue: Soles of the feet together, knees falling open onto pillows. Hands on your belly.

poses.name: Legs on a chair
poses.cue: Lie on your back with your calves resting on a chair seat. Cover yourself with a blanket.

poses.name: Rest
poses.cue: Stretch out, close your eyes and let the breath move on its own.

title: Travel Stretch
subtitle: For trains, planes and long drives
imageAlt: Clouds seen from an aeroplane window at dusk
description: Small movements you can do in a seat without bothering anyone. Helps stiffness and keeps the blood moving on a long journey.

poses.name: Seated breath
poses.cue: Sit back in your seat with both feet on the floor. Breathe slowly through your nose.

poses.name: Ankle pumps
poses.cue: Lift your toes, then your heels, in a slow rhythm. Keep going a little longer than you want to.

poses.name: Knee lifts
poses.cue: Lift one knee a few centimetres, lower it, then the other. Like walking in your seat.

poses.name: Shoulder rolls
poses.cue: Roll your shoulders up, back and down, slowly. Let them settle a little lower each time.

poses.name: Seated neck stretch
poses.cue: Tilt one ear toward your shoulder. Let the opposite shoulder stay heavy.

poses.name: Seated neck stretch
poses.cue: Tilt one ear toward your shoulder. Let the opposite shoulder stay heavy.

poses.name: Seated twist
poses.cue: Hold the armrest and turn gently from your belly, then your chest. Never force it.

poses.name: Seated twist
poses.cue: Hold the armrest and turn gently from your belly, then your chest. Never force it.

poses.name: Seated cat–cow
poses.cue: Hands on your knees: arch forward as you breathe in, round your back as you breathe out.

poses.name: Closing breath
poses.cue: Close your eyes for a few breaths and let your body settle into the seat.

title: Yoga at the Wall
subtitle: A little extra support
imageAlt: A sunlit white wall with the shadow of a plant
description: Familiar poses with a wall to lean on, so you can feel the shape without worrying about balance. Good on stiff days.

poses.name: Mountain at the wall
poses.cue: Stand with your back against the wall, heels a little away. Feel the back of your head touch it.

poses.name: Wall push-away
poses.cue: Hands on the wall at chest height. Bend your elbows slowly, then press away.

poses.name: Wall downward dog
poses.cue: Hands on the wall, walk your feet back and hinge until your back is long. Soft knees.

poses.name: Wall calf stretch
poses.cue: Step one foot back and press the heel down. Keep your hips facing the wall.

poses.name: Wall calf stretch
poses.cue: Step one foot back and press the heel down. Keep your hips facing the wall.

poses.name: Wall tree pose
poses.cue: One hand on the wall, rest the other foot on your ankle or calf — never the knee.

poses.name: Wall tree pose
poses.cue: One hand on the wall, rest the other foot on your ankle or calf — never the knee.

poses.name: Wall quad stretch
poses.cue: One hand on the wall, hold your other foot and draw it gently toward your seat.

poses.name: Wall quad stretch
poses.cue: One hand on the wall, hold your other foot and draw it gently toward your seat.

poses.name: Legs up the wall
poses.cue: Lie with your seat near the wall and rest your legs up it. Let them be completely heavy.

poses.name: Rest
poses.cue: Bring your knees in, roll to one side, and stay there for a few breaths.

title: Calm the Nerves
subtitle: Slow down a racing body
imageAlt: Gentle waves meeting a quiet beach under a pale sky
description: For when you feel wired or on edge. Long out-breaths, forward folds and grounding poses to help the body settle.

poses.name: Grounding breath
poses.cue: Sit or lie down. Breathe in for four, out for six. Let the out-breath be the longer one.

poses.name: Child’s pose
poses.cue: Sit back toward your heels and rest your forehead down. Feel your back rise as you breathe.

poses.name: Cat–cow
poses.cue: On hands and knees, move slowly with the breath. There is no rush.

poses.name: Seated forward fold
poses.cue: Sit with your legs out and fold forward over a pillow. Let your head rest.

poses.name: Reclined twist
poses.cue: Lying down, let both knees fall to one side and turn your head the other way.

poses.name: Reclined twist
poses.cue: Lying down, let both knees fall to one side and turn your head the other way.

poses.name: Knees to chest
poses.cue: Hug your knees in and rock gently side to side.

poses.name: Rest with a hand on your heart
poses.cue: Lie still with one hand on your chest and one on your belly. Feel them slow down.
